sources.provider: European Union / ESA, Copernicus Sentinel-2, read through Google Earth Engine
sources.edition: Sentinel-2 MSI Level-2A surface reflectance, harmonized
sources.resolution: 10 m, 20 m and 60 m bands; the detector reads a 20 m grid

licence.name: Copernicus Sentinel Data Terms and Conditions (Sentinel Data Legal Notice)

sources.modification: Monthly baselines (median and standard deviation) and per-date mosaics on a 20 m grid, spectral indices, and change detection; the alerts are derived vectors, not imagery.

sources.dataset: Mapas Anuais de Cobertura e Uso da Terra do Brasil com 10 metros de resolução espacial

sources.modification: Cropped to the window (-41.0, -8.0, -38.8, -6.8) on the native grid; classes regrouped into the project's five groups; the fraction of natural vegetation under each alert computed from the crop.
